text:
JB - you're the first of the three greatest gifts of my life; hold strong and never give up your identity, nor your truth. many adults said this starting when you were 4: "he's an adult disguised as a tiny kid". it's amazing to see how much you've grown in every way possible at such a young age, and now you're taller than me & plenty mature enough to decide who you are - nobody else can decide that for you, no matter how much they try

M - i've said plenty enough already, so i'll make this the last. i hope you know how incredible you are, and i hope you always surround yourself with people who know it and appreciate it too

MC - i can never thank you enough for everything you did to set the foundation for who i was always supposed to be. i'm so excited to keep watching our children contribute so much love & greatness to this world, together

KT - i'm so grateful for you and how much you've supported me through the toughest times

KY - my brother. wish i was still on the front lines with you, but you never needed me there in the first place. love you, little guy :)

MC & MD - thanks for still ballin' with a potential ball knower

TP - family - we will run it back and make our drift king videos someday

JD - 20+ years later, bro... so happy we picked right back up to do even cooler shit than before

WSF - you know i had to :)

bm hollyhock crew - y'all helped me unlock the best version of myself - thank you

f&f crew - i already miss the heck out of y'all, and owe y'all conversations about Diddy, YCSE, Cape Fear. i hope to be able to do that someday, but not sure when that can be

to everyone else who has contributed to this crazy life of mine (so, so many people) - no matter which direction our path ultimately went/ended, it all needed to happen exactly the way it did for us to end up where we are right now

never look back

(okay, don't expect most of these tweets to be deep - i have to enjoy my stupid humor by being stupid most of the time)
